wmc_usher.text: Welcome to the Wales Millennium Centre. It opened in 2004 and it is the home of Welsh National Opera.
Look up at the front. The huge poem is by Gwyneth Lewis. In English it reads: In these stones horizons sing.
The Welsh line is Creu gwir fel gwydr o ffwrnais awen. The building is wrapped in Welsh slate in many shades, from several different quarries.

wmc_harpist.text: The acoustics here are famous, so please hush while I tune. It takes me longer than the show.
